prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved face reference for an adult Japanese-inspired Asian woman, preserving approved-adult facial structure and likeness without exact-match or real-person-photography wording. She has a sweet elegant face, wears a minimalist pure black dress, bold red lips, and fair skin. From 0-3 seconds, cut in from a close-up with half-lowered eyes; her gaze slowly lifts toward the camera as she leans slightly forward. From 3-7 seconds, she tilts her head, hair brushes the cheek, she slow-blinks, half-smiles, and turns from a side-face camera lock to the front. From 7-10 seconds, she makes a restrained confident expression and the camera freezes on the facial close-up. From 10-12 seconds, she says "Chanel" with a French accent and an advertising feel. Use face close-ups and medium shots, stable follow movement, slight push and pull, a 45-degree side angle turning front, cool soft light, high-end cinematic texture, and natural smooth movement.
